about_the_game:
A wandering team of adventurers stumble upon a powerful, magically-infused dragon heart. They decide to harness this power in order to create a settlement for themselves and other adventurers. As the town becomes larger, the settlers realize they are not alone, there are small encampments of many sorts of foes, from goblins, to giants, to the undead! After banding together and killing the dragon, the monsters have used its carcass as power for their settlements. However, they must have missed the most powerful remnant of them all, the heart! These fiends have guarded their most valuable treasure, the dragon’s fossils, with their lives. If one could combine the heart with all the fossils who knows what may happen?

Features include:

  • City Building - Construct and upgrade buildings to increase your power and to grow your settlement into a bustling city!

  • Dungeon Crawler Mini-game - Explore your way through dungeons and defeat monsters though D&D-style combat.

short_description: In Cor Draconis, players gather a team of magical adventurers, conquering dungeons and collecting enough fossils to revive the dragon that once protected the lands. Grow your settlement into a bustling city, rid the land of monsters, and restore magic and peace to the nation once more!
